newsitem.title: USA: Security-Connecticut shares up on deal.
newsitem.headline: Security-Connecticut shares up on deal.

text.p: Shares of insurance company Security-Connecticut Corp rose 8-1/8 at 45-5/8 after it signed a definitive merger agreement with ReliaStar Financial Corp that values Security-Connectict at $47 a share.
"I think it's a good deal. Security-Connecticut...was not getting any recognition in the market for what they were doing and the potential there," Nutmeg Securities analyst Ira Zuckerman said.
Dain Bosworth analyst J. Chris Sergeant said he considers ReliaStar's $488 million offer for Security-Connecticut to be "reasonable."
"The stock has done very well already," Sergeant added. "It was at its all-time high and fully valued in the near-term."
The company said the deal will be neutral to earnings in 1997 and modestly additive in 1998.
